description: Spec assumes each instance's EVM wallet lives at $ANICCA_HOME/.automaton/wallet.json (REQ-R1 spec.md:402, REQ-R2 spec.md:410, REQ-S5 spec.md:329). The real runtime resolves it from process.env.HOME, never ANICCA_HOME: proxy.mjs:9, execute-yield.mjs:54, hl.py:44, anicca-daemon.sh:54. A child (REQ-S2 writes $CHILD_HOME/.automaton/wallet.json, spec.md:273) shares $HOME with the parent, so the child's proxy/yield/trade code reads the PARENT wallet. Child seed is never used; parent funds pay for and sign child trades. Wallet isolation (REQ-R2 acceptance) is broken; spawn spends parent funds unsafely. No REQ modifies proxy/daemon/execute-yield to honor ANICCA_HOME, so the spec is infeasible and money-unsafe as written.
